You can browse through available crags either from by map view or from a comprehensive country list.

Navigation

Finding your climbing rocks from your wish list is also easy with Topo Guru. Our partners and crag-masters save the GPS coordinates for each photo and we can show you detailed information. Use our in-app compass to find your way through blocks and to see the distance from your destination.
Topo Guru provides “How to get there” information and helps you find the best parking spots by GPS.

Crag Info

The crag database contains useful particulars such as: rock and climbing type, season, how to get there, recommended accommodation for climbers, food and rest day activities, etc.

Climbing log

You can easily save your climbing log after you finished the route and retrieve it any time.


Climbing grade converter

You never know which scale they use at your next climbing trip. Try our grade converter and switch scales back and forth, any time you want.

Subscriptions

Besides free features, most of the climbing topos are available only with paid subscription. You can unlock all content (including all topos) with an auto-renewable subscription. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
